paint.viewer.override.square_override

Class WriteSquareOverride

  • java.lang.Object
    • paint.viewer.override.square_override.WriteSquareOverride

  • public class WriteSquareOverride
extends Object
    Writes and maintains per-square cell assignment overrides for the PAINT Viewer.

    Overrides are stored in <project>/Viewer/Square Override.csv. Each row identifies a square using (experimentName, recordingName, squareNumber) and provides an overridden cellId plus a timestamp. This class performs disk I/O only; it does not apply overrides to in-memory Square instances.

    • Method Detail

      • writeSquareOverridesToFile

        public void writeSquareOverridesToFile(RecordingEntry recordingEntry,
                                       Map<Integer,Integer> assignments)
        Writes or updates the cell assignment overrides for selected squares.

        The provided assignments are merged into any existing overrides:

        • If cellId == 0, the override row for that square is removed.
        • Otherwise, the square’s row is added or replaced with the new cellId and timestamp.
        Parameters:
        recordingEntry - the recording entry to update
        assignments - map of squareNumber → cellId
